dialogue: You reach the edge of the settlement.
The walls are real. The people inside are real.
This is the end of one chapter — and the start of the next.

choices.lockedText: You can't read the situation from here.

dialogue: You study the settlement for a long moment.
The guards rotate on a schedule. No unusual tension.
These people have held this place for a while.
You decide it's safe enough to approach.
A woman with tired eyes but a steady voice greets you.
'We don't have much. But we have each other.'
It's not much. But for the first time in a long time, it feels like enough.
